_doc: writes_paths is empty because debug_case.py default --output-dir is $CODEX_HOME/aqg-debug-cases (outside the AQG repo, schema disallows ~ / absolute paths). Users may pass --output-dir docs/debugging-cases/ to write project-relative; in that case the project path is user-controlled, not skill-asserted boundary.
name: aqg-systematic-debugging
description: Root-cause debugging workflow for unresolved project failures or contradictory evidence, including failing checks, CI errors, and preflight failures. Use it to build a reproducible feedback loop, test one hypothesis at a time, and verify a minimal fix before proposing changes; do not use it for ordinary implementation, review, or already-understood small fixes.

sentence_patterns: I need to figure out why this preflight is failing
Help me trace the root cause of this evidence mismatch

cli_contract.0: success — case notes created or validation passed
cli_contract.1: validation failed — case file missing required sections / fields
cli_contract.2: usage error — invalid arguments or unknown subcommand

owner_only_actions: Production / branch protection / Owner-admin actions remain separate authorization gates

cases.prompt: CI has failed three times in a row — help me chase the root cause, don't paper over it
Preflight failure — symptom is dirty worktree but git status looks clean, evidence disagrees
The audit tool's finding doesn't match the actual code — I need to do a root-cause analysis
Tests pass locally but fail on CI — figure out the boundary before guessing
Use /aqg-systematic-debugging to work through this failure
